title: Job Producer Module Compiler
description: Compiles a typed job enqueue module for BullMQ/Bull/pg-boss. Enforces: job payload validated against schema before enqueue, queue name from topology (not hardcoded), no fire-and-forget (enqueue result must be awaited), job options from spec (delay, priority, attempts).

error_codes.JP002: queue-topology-artifact.json not found — compile queue-topology first
error_codes.JP003: Job payload not validated before enqueue (no schema parse/validate call)
error_codes.JP004: Queue name hardcoded as string literal — must come from topology constant
error_codes.JP005: Enqueue call not awaited — fire-and-forget job enqueue detected
error_codes.JP006: Job options (delay, priority, attempts) not sourced from spec
